delta.comment: Staging-PR readiness finding P1 corrected. Prior acceptance criteria sequenced the out-of-scope thread reply BEFORE the C2 deferred-entry capture and did not require the reply to cite the generated deferred expansion ID. That contradicted P-021 C2 (capture is a precondition for closing the finding) and C3 (reference the deferred entry ID in the review-thread reply and residual-risk record), and diverged from 134.004-T. Acceptance criteria and implementation notes now mandate the capture-first order: C2 capture -> substantive reply citing the generated deferred entry ID -> thread resolution -> PR residual-risk record naming the same ID, plus an explicit prohibition on replying/resolving before capture exists and an explicit consistency constraint against 134.004-T.
